```ts
const start = useCallback(async (): Promise<boolean> => {
  if (capturingRef.current) return true
  setError(null)
  if (simulateRef.current) {
    capturingRef.current = true
    setIsCapturing(true)
    return true
  }
  if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
    setError("Microphone access is not supported in this browser")
    return false
  }

  let mediaStream: MediaStream
  try {
    mediaStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
      audio: {
        channelCount: 1,
        echoCancellation: true,
        noiseSuppression: true,
        autoGainControl: true,
      },
    })
  } catch (cause) {
    setError(captureErrorMessage(cause))
    return false
  }

  streamRef.current = mediaStream
  let audioContext: AudioContext
  try {
    const contextCtor = window.AudioContext ?? (window as any).webkitAudioContext
    try {
      audioContext = new contextCtor({ sampleRate: targetSampleRateRef.current })
    } catch {
      audioContext = new contextCtor()
    }
    if (audioContext.state === "suspended") {
      await audioContext.resume()
    }
    await audioContext.audioWorklet.addModule(new URL("../audio/pcmCaptureWorklet.ts", import.meta.url).href)
  } catch (cause) {
    teardown(true)
    setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Unable to start audio capture")
    return false
  }
  audioContextRef.current = audioContext

  try {
    const node = new AudioWorkletNode(audioContext, "pcm-capture-processor", {
      numberOfInputs: 1,
      numberOfOutputs: 1,
      channelCount: 1,
      channelCountMode: "explicit",
      channelInterpretation: "speakers",
    })
    const muteGain = audioContext.createGain()
    muteGain.gain.value = 0
    const source = audioContext.createMediaStreamSource(mediaStream)
    source.connect(node)
    node.connect(muteGain)
    muteGain.connect(audioContext.destination)

    const chunkSamples = Math.max(1, Math.round(targetSampleRateRef.current * chunkSizeMsRef.current / 1000))
    node.port.postMessage({
      type: "configure",
      outputSampleRate: targetSampleRateRef.current,
      chunkSamples,
      speechThreshold: 0.012,
      hangoverMs: 350,
    })
    node.port.onmessage = (event: MessageEvent<...>) => {
      const message = event.data
      if (message?.type === "audio" && message.buffer instanceof ArrayBuffer) {
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(message.buffer)
        bytesSentRef.current += bytes.byteLength
        chunksRef.current += 1
        onChunkRef.current?.(bytes)
      } else if (message?.type === "activity") {
        setActivityAvailable(true)
        setIsSpeaking(Boolean(message.active))
      }
    }

    workletNodeRef.current = node
    sourceNodeRef.current = source
    muteGainRef.current = muteGain
    setSampleRate(audioContext.sampleRate)
    setChunkSizeBytes(chunkSamples * 2)
    chunksRef.current = 0
    bytesSentRef.current = 0
    lastStatsCountRef.current = 0

    capturingRef.current = true
    setStream(mediaStream)
    setIsCapturing(true)
    statsTimerRef.current = window.setInterval(() => {
      const chunks = chunksRef.current
      setChunksPerSecond(chunks - lastStatsCountRef.current)
      lastStatsCountRef.current = chunks
      setBytesSent(bytesSentRef.current)
    }, 1000)
    return true
  } catch (cause) {
    teardown(true)
    setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Unable to start audio capture")
    return false
  }
}, [teardown])
```

`captureErrorMessage` helper:
```ts
function captureErrorMessage(cause: unknown): string {
  if (cause instanceof DOMException) {
    switch (cause.name) {
      case "NotAllowedError":
        return "Microphone permission was denied. Allow microphone access in your browser and try again."
      case "NotFoundError":
        return "No microphone was found on this device."
      case "NotReadableError":
        return "The microphone is in use by another application or is not readable."
      case "OverconstrainedError":
        return "No microphone matching the requested settings was found."
      default:
        return cause.message || "Unable to access the microphone."
    }
  }
  return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Unable to access the microphone."
}
```

```tsx
import type { ConnectionState } from "../../types"

export interface DiagnosticsPanelProps {
  sampleRate: number | null
  chunkSizeBytes: number
  chunksPerSecond: number
  bytesSent: number
  bytesReceived: number
  connectionState: ConnectionState
}

function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} MB`
}

export function DiagnosticsPanel({ sampleRate, chunkSizeBytes, chunksPerSecond, bytesSent, bytesReceived, connectionState }: DiagnosticsPanelProps) {
  return (
    <section className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm">
      <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Audio diagnostics (dev)</h2>
      <dl className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-4 gap-y-2 font-mono text-sm sm:grid-cols-3">
        <Row label="Sample rate" value={sampleRate ? `${sampleRate.toLocaleString()} Hz` : "—"} />
        <Row label="Chunk size" value={`${chunkSizeBytes} B`} />
        <Row label="Chunks / sec" value={chunksPerSecond.toFixed(0)} />
        <Row label="Bytes sent" value={formatBytes(bytesSent)} />
        <Row label="Bytes received (server)" value={formatBytes(bytesReceived)} />
        <Row label="WebSocket state" value={connectionState} />
      </dl>
    </section>
  )
}
```

  "content": "/* AudioWorklet processor that converts raw Float32 microphone frames into\n * small 16 kHz mono PCM16 chunks and posts them to the main thread.\n *\n * It runs off the main thread on the AudioContext's render thread. It:\n *   - resamples the incoming stream to the ASR target rate (16 kHz) with a\n *     cheap linear interpolator,\n *   - buffers the resampled frames into fixed-size chunks (no extra latency\n *     beyond one chunk duration),\n *   - converts Float32 -> little-endian Int16 and posts the ArrayBuffer\n *     (transferred, so zero copies),\n *   - does a basic RMS-based activity check to drive the UI's\n *     Listening / Speaking indicator.\n */\n\ndeclare const sampleRate: number\ndeclare function registerProcessor(\n  name: string,\n  processorCtor: new () => AudioWorkletProcessor,\n): void\n\ninterface WorkletConfig {\n  type: \"configure\"\n  outputSampleRate: number\n  chunkSamples: number\n  speechThreshold: number\n  hangoverMs: number\n}\n\ninterface WorkletRequest {\n  type: string\n  outputSampleRate?: number\n  chunkSamples?: number\n  speechThreshold?: number\n  hangoverMs?: number\n}\n\nclass PcmCaptureProcessor extends AudioWorkletProcessor {\n  private queue: number[] = []\n  private frac0 = 0\n  private ratio = 1\n  private chunkSamples = 1600\n  private speechThreshold = 0.012\n  private hangoverSeconds = 0.35\n  private speaking = false\n  private hangoverRemaining = 0\n\n  constructor() {\n    super()\n    this.port.onmessage = (event: MessageEvent<WorkletRequest>) => {\n      const message = event.data\n      if (message?.type !== \"configure\") return\n      this.applyConfig(message)\n    }\n  }\n\n  process(inputs: Float32Array[][], _outputs: Float32Array[][]): boolean {\n    const input = inputs[0]?.[0]\n    if (input && input.length > 0) {\n      this.pushResampled(input)\n      this.updateActivity(input)\n    }\n\n    if (this.queue.length >= this.chunkSamples) {\n      const samples = this.queue.splice(0, this.chunkSamples)\n      const pcm = new Int16Array(samples.length)\n      for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i += 1) {\n        let value = samples[i]\n        if (value > 1) value = 1\n        else if (value < -1) value = -1\n        pcm[i] = value < 0 ? value * 0x8000 : value * 0x7fff\n      }\n      this.port.postMessage({ type: \"audio\", buffer: pcm.buffer }, [pcm.buffer])\n    }\n\n    return true\n  }\n\n  private applyConfig(message: WorkletRequest): void {\n    this.chunkSamples = message.chunkSamples ?? this.chunkSamples\n    this.speechThreshold = message.speechThreshold ?? this.speechThreshold\n    this.hangoverSeconds = (message.hangoverMs ?? this.hangoverSeconds * 1000) / 1000\n    this.ratio = sampleRate / (message.outputSampleRate ?? this.ratio)\n    this.frac0 = 0\n    this.queue.length = 0\n  }\n\n  private pushResampled(input: Float32Array): void {\n    const last = input.length - 1\n    if (last < 0) return\n    let position = this.frac0\n    while (position <= last) {\n      const i0 = Math.floor(position)\n      const i1 = i0 < last ? i0 + 1 : last\n      const fraction = position - i0\n      this.queue.push(input[i0] * (1 - fraction) + input[i1] * fraction)\n      position += this.ratio\n    }\n    this.frac0 = position - last\n  }\n\n  private updateActivity(input: Float32Array): void {\n    let sumOfSquares = 0\n    for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i += 1) {\n      const value = input[i]\n      sumOfSquares += value * value\n    }\n    const rms = Math.sqrt(sumOfSquares / input.length)\n    const quantumSeconds = input.length / sampleRate\n\n    if (rms >= this.speechThreshold) {\n      this.hangoverRemaining = this.hangoverSeconds\n      if (!this.speaking) {\n        this.speaking = true\n        this.port.postMessage({ type: \"activity\", active: true })\n      }\n    } else if (this.speaking) {\n      this.hangoverRemaining -= quantumSeconds\n      if (this.hangoverRemaining <= 0) {\n        this.speaking = false\n        this.port.postMessage({ type: \"activity\", active: false })\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nregisterProcessor(\"pcm-capture-processor\", PcmCaptureProcessor)\n"
}

  "content": "/* AudioWorklet processor that converts raw Float32 microphone frames into\n * small 16 kHz mono PCM16 chunks and posts them to the main thread.\n *\n * It runs off the main thread on the AudioContext's render thread. It:\n *   - resamples the incoming stream to the ASR target rate (16 kHz) with a\n *     cheap linear interpolator,\n *   - buffers the resampled frames into fixed-size chunks (no extra latency\n *     beyond one chunk duration),\n *   - converts Float32 -> little-endian Int16 and posts the ArrayBuffer\n *     (transferred, so zero copies),\n *   - does a basic RMS-based activity check to drive the UI's\n *     Listening / Speaking indicator.\n *\n * This file must stay self-contained (no imports) and plain JavaScript:\n * AudioWorklet.addModule loads it directly, so it cannot go through the\n * bundler's module pipeline.\n */\n\"use strict\"\n\nclass PcmCaptureProcessor extends AudioWorkletProcessor {\n  constructor() {\n    super()\n    this.queue = []\n    this.frac0 = 0\n    this.ratio = 1\n    this.chunkSamples = 1600\n    this.speechThreshold = 0.012\n    this.hangoverSeconds = 0.35\n    this.speaking = false\n    this.hangoverRemaining = 0\n\n    this.port.onmessage = (event) => {\n      const message = event.data\n      if (!message || message.type !== \"configure\") return\n      this.applyConfig(message)\n    }\n  }\n\n  process(inputs, _outputs) {\n    const input = inputs[0] && inputs[0][0]\n    if (input && input.length > 0) {\n      this.pushResampled(input)\n      this.updateActivity(input)\n    }\n\n    if (this.queue.length >= this.chunkSamples) {\n      const samples = this.queue.splice(0, this.chunkSamples)\n      const pcm = new Int16Array(samples.length)\n      for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i += 1) {\n        let value = samples[i]\n        if (value > 1) value = 1\n        else if (value < -1) value = -1\n        pcm[i] = value < 0 ? value * 0x8000 : value * 0x7fff\n      }\n      this.port.postMessage({ type: \"audio\", buffer: pcm.buffer }, [pcm.buffer])\n    }\n\n    return true\n  }\n\n  applyConfig(message) {\n    if (typeof message.chunkSamples === \"number\") {\n      this.chunkSamples = message.chunkSamples\n    }\n    if (typeof message.speechThreshold === \"number\") {\n      this.speechThreshold = message.speechThreshold\n    }\n    if (typeof message.hangoverMs === \"number\") {\n      this.hangoverSeconds = message.hangoverMs / 1000\n    }\n    if (typeof message.outputSampleRate === \"number\") {\n      this.ratio = sampleRate / message.outputSampleRate\n    }\n    this.frac0 = 0\n    this.queue.length = 0\n  }\n\n  pushResampled(input) {\n    const last = input.length - 1\n    if (last < 0) return\n    let position = this.frac0\n    while (position <= last) {\n      const i0 = Math.floor(position)\n      const i1 = i0 < last ? i0 + 1 : last\n      const fraction = position - i0\n      this.queue.push(input[i0] * (1 - fraction) + input[i1] * fraction)\n      position += this.ratio\n    }\n    this.frac0 = position - last\n  }\n\n  updateActivity(input) {\n    let sumOfSquares = 0\n    for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i += 1) {\n      const value = input[i]\n      sumOfSquares += value * value\n    }\n    const rms = Math.sqrt(sumOfSquares / input.length)\n    const quantumSeconds = input.length / sampleRate\n\n    if (rms >= this.speechThreshold) {\n      this.hangoverRemaining = this.hangoverSeconds\n      if (!this.speaking) {\n        this.speaking = true\n        this.port.postMessage({ type: \"activity\", active: true })\n      }\n    } else if (this.speaking) {\n      this.hangoverRemaining -= quantumSeconds\n      if (this.hangoverRemaining <= 0) {\n        this.speaking = false\n        this.port.postMessage({ type: \"activity\", active: false })\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nregisterProcessor(\"pcm-capture-processor\", PcmCaptureProcessor)\n"
}

## Assistant (Build · Big Pickle · 7.6s)

Done. Real microphone capture is implemented and verified end-to-end.

**What changed**
- `frontend/src/audio/pcmCaptureWorklet.js` — AudioWorklet processor: resamples to 16 kHz mono, buffers 100 ms chunks, converts to little-endian PCM16, posts buffers with zero-copy transfer, and does RMS-based activity detection (with hangover) for the UI indicator.
- `useAudioCapture.ts` — `getUserMedia` → `AudioContext` → `AudioWorkletNode` (muted gain, no feedback). Requested `sampleRate: 16000` with fallback to default (worklet still resamples). Graceful permission-denied/not-found/in-use errors, clean stop (track stop + context close + port close), and stats (sample rate, chunk size, chunks/sec, bytes sent).
- `useTranslatorSession.ts` — `audio_received` ack tracking + `setSpeaking()`; App drives Listening/Speaking from local activity only when available.
- Fake ASR removed: backend no longer emits simulated transcripts/translations (deleted `simulation.py`, silence-finalization machinery), and `mockStreamingClient` no longer fakes results. `wsClient.sendAudio` drops audio while disconnected (no buffering).
- Backend sends a throttled `audio_received` ack (chunks/bytes/seconds) + INFO log, so real mic audio arrival is observable.
- `DiagnosticsPanel` (dev only): sample rate, chunk size, chunks/sec, bytes sent, bytes received, WebSocket state.
- `vite.config.ts`: `assetsInlineLimit: 0` — AudioWorklet needs a real JS module URL (the worklet was being inlined as a `data:` URL, which `addModule` rejects).

**Verified**
- Backend: `pytest` 15 passed, `ruff` clean; live WS test confirmed `session_started` → `audio_received` (3200 B) → `session_stopped`.
- Frontend: `tsc`, `eslint`, `vite build` all clean; dev server serves the worklet as `text/javascript`.

(The long delay earlier was just my background-process cleanup fighting stale duplicate servers, not a bug.)

One note: transcript/translation panels are intentionally empty now — ASR isn't implemented yet, per your instructions.

<content>
1: # Real-Time Translator
2: 
3: A real-time, multilingual speech translator for online meetings (Zoom, Google Meet, etc.).
4: Streams live speech to text, translates it, and displays translated captions with
5: minimal latency — with silence detection used to produce clean sentence boundaries
6: and punctuation.
7: 
8: > **Status:** scaffolding complete. Provider interfaces, app structure, and both
9: > frontend/backend skeletons are in place and boot successfully. Concrete provider
10: > implementations (Deepgram streaming, cloud translation, NLLB fallback, Silero VAD
11: > worklet, LLM refinement) are the next build phase — see `DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md`.
12: 
13: ## What this is
14: 
15: - **ASR:** Deepgram Streaming API (default), behind an `ASRProvider` interface.
16: - **Translation:** hybrid — a low-latency cloud provider by default, with NLLB-200
17:   as an offline/fallback provider, behind a `TranslationProvider` interface.
18: - **VAD (silence detection):** client-side Silero VAD running in an AudioWorklet,
19:   so silence detection never adds server round-trip latency.
20: - **LLM refinement:** an async, post-hoc pass that improves punctuation,
21:   capitalization, obvious ASR errors, and contextual terminology — it runs
22:   **after** an utterance is finalized and is never on the latency-critical path.
23: 
24: ## Project structure
25: 
26: ```
27: real-time-translator/
28: ├── frontend/          React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind UI
29: ├── backend/           FastAPI + asyncio + WebSocket pipeline
30: ├── docs/              Supplementary docs (provider setup, protocol notes)
31: ├── tests/             Cross-cutting / integration tests (root level)
32: ├── .env.example       All environment variables, documented
33: ├── .gitignore
34: ├── README.md          You are here
35: ├── ARCHITECTURE.md    System design, data flow, provider abstractions
36: └── DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md  Phased build-out plan and current status
37: ```
38: 
39: See `ARCHITECTURE.md` for the full system design and `backend/app/services/*`
40: for the provider interfaces (`ASRProvider`, `TranslationProvider`, `LLMProvider`)
41: that keep business logic decoupled from any single vendor.
42: 
43: ## Prerequisites
44: 
45: - Python 3.11 or 3.12 (backend). `backend/.python-version` pins 3.12.
46: - Node.js 20+ and npm (frontend).
47: - [`uv`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) for Python dependency management (recommended),
48:   or plain `pip` + `venv`.
49: - API keys for whichever providers you enable (Deepgram, a cloud translation
50:   provider, an LLM provider) — see `.env.example`.
51: 
52: > A note on Python versions: the repository was originally scaffolded with
53: > Python 3.14. The backend pins `>=3.11,<3.13` instead, because the ML stack
54: > used by the offline NLLB-200 fallback (`torch`, `transformers`) does not yet
55: > have stable wheels for 3.14. If you don't need the offline fallback, feel
56: > free to loosen this constraint.
57: 
58: ## Getting started
59: 
60: ### Backend
61: 
62: ```bash
63: cd backend
64: uv sync                       # or: python -m venv .venv && pip install -e .
65: cp ../.env.example .env       # then fill in DEEPGRAM_API_KEY etc.
66: uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
67: ```
68: 
69: Verify it's up:
70: 
71: ```bash
72: curl http://localhost:8000/health
73: ```
74: 
75: ### Frontend
76: 
77: ```bash
78: cd frontend
79: npm install
80: npm run dev
81: ```
82: 
83: Open the URL Vite prints (default `http://localhost:5173`). The Vite dev server
84: proxies `/api` and `/ws` to `http://localhost:8000` (see `frontend/vite.config.ts`),
85: so the frontend and backend can be developed independently.
86: 
87: ### Running tests
88: 
89: ```bash
90: # Backend
91: cd backend && uv run pytest
92: 
93: # Frontend (once wired up)
94: cd frontend && npm run lint
95: ```
96: 
97: ## Design principles
98: 
99: 1. **Provider abstractions everywhere.** `ASRProvider`, `TranslationProvider`,
100:    `LLMProvider`, and a client-side `VADProvider` mean no business logic is
101:    tightly coupled to Deepgram, a specific translation API, or a specific LLM.
102: 2. **Latency-critical path stays lean.** ASR → translation → display is the hot
103:    path. LLM refinement is strictly async and only ever *improves* text already
104:    shown to the user — it never blocks it.
105: 3. **Silence is signal.** Client-side VAD silence events double as endpointing
106:    hints, giving cleaner sentence boundaries and punctuation than relying on
107:    ASR endpointing alone.
108: 4. **UI needs no manual.** Two panels (original / translation), one big
109:    start/stop control, obvious connection and latency indicators.
110: 
111: ## Roadmap
112: 
113: See `DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md` for the phased plan, from this scaffold through

<content>
1: # Architecture
2: 
3: ## 1. Goals and constraints
4: 
5: - **Low latency end-to-end.** Speech must appear as translated captions within a
6:   few hundred milliseconds, not seconds.
7: - **Provider independence.** Deepgram, the cloud translation API, NLLB-200, and
8:   the LLM refinement provider must all be swappable without touching pipeline
9:   or UI code. This is enforced with abstract provider interfaces.
10: - **Correctness improves without blocking speed.** Punctuation/terminology
11:   refinement is valuable but must never sit on the hot path.
12: - **Silence is a first-class signal**, not just "no audio" — it's used both to
13:   save bandwidth/compute and to produce clean sentence boundaries.
14: - **Extensible to meeting audio.** The pipeline should not assume "microphone"
15:   as the only audio source; system/meeting audio capture is a planned input,
16:   not an architectural afterthought.
17: 
18: ## 2. High-level data flow
19: 
20: ```
21: ┌─────────────┐   PCM frames    ┌──────────────────┐
22: │  Microphone /│ ───────────────▶│  Silero VAD       │  (AudioWorklet, client-side)
23: │  meeting audio│                │  speech/silence   │
24: └─────────────┘                 └─────────┬─────────┘
25:                                            │ speech_start / speech_end events
26:                                            ▼
27:                               ┌────────────────────────┐
28:                               │  Audio capture pipeline  │  (client-side)
29:                               │  getUserMedia → Worklet  │
30:                               └────────────┬─────────────┘
31:                                            │ 16kHz PCM frames + silence events
32:                                            ▼  (WebSocket, binary + JSON control)
33:                               ┌────────────────────────┐
34:                               │   FastAPI WS endpoint    │  backend/app/websocket
35:                               │   /ws/audio               │
36:                               └────────────┬─────────────┘
37:                                            │
38:                           ┌────────────────┼────────────────┐
39:                           ▼                                   ▼
40:               ┌─────────────────────┐             notify_silence() hints
41:               │   ASRProvider         │◀───────────────────────────────┐
42:               │   (Deepgram default)  │                                 │
43:               └───────────┬───────────┘                                 │
44:                           │ partial + final TranscriptSegment            │
45:                           ▼                                              │
46:               ┌─────────────────────┐                                   │
47:               │  TranslationProvider  │  hybrid: cloud (default) ────────┘
48:               │  cloud / NLLB          │  or NLLB-200 (fallback/offline)
49:               └───────────┬───────────┘
50:                           │ partial + final TranslationSegment
51:                           ▼
52:               ┌─────────────────────┐        (fire-and-forget, async)
53:               │  Client (React UI)    │◀────────────┐
54:               │  transcript + captions │             │
55:               └───────────┬───────────┘             │
56:                           │ final segment id          │
57:                           ▼                            │
58:               ┌─────────────────────┐                 │
59:               │   LLMProvider          │────────────────┘
60:               │   async refinement pass │  REFINEMENT event, replaces
61:               └─────────────────────┘  displayed text in place, non-blocking
62: ```
63: 
64: Key point: **the LLM box is not in the request/response chain that produces the
65: first visible caption.** It's triggered after a segment is finalized, runs in
66: a background asyncio task, and pushes a correction later via a separate
67: `refinement` WebSocket event. The UI already has *something* on screen; the
68: refinement just makes it better.
69: 
70: ## 3. Provider abstractions
71: 
72: All providers are ABCs so the pipeline/orchestrator and the UI depend only on
73: interfaces, never concrete vendors.
74: 
75: ### `ASRProvider` (`backend/app/services/asr/base.py`)
76: 
77: ```
78: connect(sample_rate, encoding, language) -> None
79: send_audio(chunk: bytes) -> None
80: notify_silence(duration_ms: int) -> None
81: stream() -> AsyncIterator[TranscriptSegment]
82: close() -> None
83: ```
84: 
85: `DeepgramASRProvider` is the default implementation. `notify_silence` maps to
86: Deepgram's endpointing/finalize controls, letting client-detected silence force
87: a clean utterance boundary rather than waiting on server-side heuristics alone.
88: 
89: ### `TranslationProvider` (`backend/app/services/translation/base.py`)
90: 
91: ```
92: translate(segment_id, text, source_language, target_language, is_final) -> TranslationSegment
93: warm_up() -> None            # optional: load models / open connections
94: health_check() -> bool       # optional: used by the hybrid router
95: ```
96: 
97: Two implementations:
98: - `CloudTranslationProvider` — default. Wraps a cloud translation API
99:   (Google / DeepL / Azure, selected via config) for lowest latency.
100: - `NLLBTranslationProvider` — offline fallback using the NLLB-200 model,
101:   used when the cloud provider's `health_check()` fails, when explicitly
102:   configured for offline operation, or for languages the cloud provider
103:   doesn't cover well.
104: 
105: A thin **hybrid router** (planned in `DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md` Phase 2) selects
106: between them per request based on `health_check()` and configuration, so
107: callers just call "the" `TranslationProvider`.
108: 
109: ### `LLMProvider` (`backend/app/services/llm/base.py`)
110: 
111: ```
112: refine(segment_id, text, language, context) -> RefinementResult
113: ```
114: 
115: `LLMRefinementProvider` is the default implementation. `context` is a short
116: window of recent finalized segments so terminology stays consistent across an
117: utterance or meeting (e.g. a company/product name transcribed inconsistently).
118: 
119: ### `VADProvider` (frontend: `frontend/src/providers/vad/types.ts`)
120: 
121: VAD runs **client-side** for latency reasons (a round-trip to the server just
122: to learn "the user stopped talking" would defeat the purpose). The interface:
123: 
124: ```
125: init() -> Promise<void>
126: start(stream: MediaStream) -> Promise<void>
127: stop() -> Promise<void>
128: onEvent(callback: (event: VADEvent) => void) -> void
129: ```
130: 
131: `SileroVADProvider` runs the Silero VAD model inside an `AudioWorkletProcessor`
132: so classification happens off the main thread, frame-by-frame, with no
133: network round trip. `speech_start`/`speech_end` events are turned into
134: `silence` WebSocket messages the backend forwards to the ASR provider as
135: endpointing hints.
136: 
137: The backend also defines a `SilenceDetector` helper
138: (`backend/app/services/vad/base.py`) that turns raw silence-duration reports
139: into a "should this finalize the utterance?" decision, using two tunables:
140: - `SILENCE_FINALIZE_MS` — how much silence implies "sentence is over".
141: - `SILENCE_MIN_SPEECH_MS` — minimum preceding speech to avoid false triggers
142:   from breath sounds / noise.
143: 
144: ## 4. Why VAD is client-side but the interface lives on both sides
145: 
146: Silero VAD executes in the browser for latency. But the *concept* of "was this
147: gap in audio significant enough to be a sentence boundary" is also useful
148: server-side (e.g. if audio ever arrives from a source without a client
149: worklet — a recorded meeting file, or server-side capture of meeting audio).
150: That's why there's a `VADProvider` interface on the frontend for the live
151: capture path, and a separate `SilenceDetector`/`VADProvider` on the backend for
152: interpreting silence signals and, later, for any server-side VAD fallback —
153: without changing how the ASR/translation pipeline consumes "silence happened
154: here" events.
155: 
156: ## 5. WebSocket protocol
157: 
158: Single endpoint: `ws://<backend>/ws/audio`. See
159: `backend/app/models/schemas.py` for exact payloads.
160: 
161: **Client → Server**
162: | Message | Shape |
163: |---|---|
164: | Start session | `{"type": "start", "source_language", "target_language", "sample_rate", "encoding"}` |
165: | Audio | binary WebSocket frame (raw PCM16 or Opus) |
166: | Silence event | `{"type": "silence", "duration_ms": N}` |
167: | Stop session | `{"type": "stop"}` |
168: 
169: **Server → Client**
170: | Message | Shape |
171: |---|---|
172: | Partial/final transcript | `{"type": "transcript_partial" \| "transcript_final", ...TranscriptSegment}` |
173: | Partial/final translation | `{"type": "translation_partial" \| "translation_final", ...TranslationSegment}` |
174: | Async refinement | `{"type": "refinement", ...RefinementResult}` |
175: | Status | `{"type": "status", "message": str}` |
176: | Error | `{"type": "error", "code": str, "message": str}` |
177: | Latency report | `{"type": "latency", ...LatencyReport}` |
178: 
179: ## 6. Frontend structure
180: 
181: ```
182: frontend/src/
183: ├── components/         one folder per reusable UI piece (own file + index.ts)
184: │   ├── LanguageSelector/
185: │   ├── AudioControls/
186: │   ├── ConnectionStatus/
187: │   ├── LatencyIndicator/
188: │   ├── ErrorBanner/
189: │   ├── TranscriptPanel/
190: │   └── TranslationPanel/
191: ├── hooks/
192: │   ├── useTranslatorSession.ts   orchestrates connection + pipeline state
193: │   └── useAudioCapture.ts        getUserMedia + AudioWorklet plumbing
194: ├── providers/
195: │   └── vad/                      VADProvider interface + SileroVADProvider
196: ├── lib/
197: │   └── wsClient.ts                thin WebSocket transport (TranslatorClient)
198: ├── types/                         shared types mirroring backend schemas
199: ├── styles/                        Tailwind entrypoint
200: ├── App.tsx                        UI shell: selectors, controls, two panels
201: └── main.tsx
202: ```
203: 
204: `useTranslatorSession` is the single seam between UI and networking/audio —
205: components never touch `WebSocket` or `MediaStream` directly, which keeps the
206: UI layer trivial to test and restyle.
207: 
208: ## 7. Backend structure
209: 
210: ```
211: backend/app/
212: ├── main.py              FastAPI app: CORS, router mounting, /health
213: ├── config.py             pydantic-settings Settings, env-driven
214: ├── websocket/
215: │   └── audio_stream.py   /ws/audio transport layer (thin)
216: ├── services/
217: │   ├── asr/               ASRProvider + DeepgramASRProvider
218: │   ├── translation/        TranslationProvider + Cloud/NLLB implementations
219: │   ├── vad/                 VADProvider + SilenceDetector
220: │   └── llm/                  LLMProvider + LLMRefinementProvider
221: ├── models/
222: │   └── schemas.py          shared Pydantic models (WS + internal)
223: └── utils/
224:     └── logging.py           structlog setup
225: ```
226: 
227: Notice `websocket/audio_stream.py` stays thin on purpose — it's transport, not
228: orchestration. As Phase 2 (see `DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md`) lands, a
229: `PipelineOrchestrator` (or similar) will sit between the transport layer and
230: the providers, owning per-session state, provider selection, and the async
231: refinement dispatch — keeping the WebSocket handler itself simple regardless
232: of how complex the pipeline gets.
233: 
234: ## 8. Path to meeting/system audio
235: 
236: Today's design already generalizes past "microphone": the WebSocket protocol
237: and `ASRProvider` interface don't care where PCM frames come from. Consuming
238: Zoom/Meet system audio is a matter of adding a capture source (e.g. a
239: platform-level loopback capture, a meeting-bot integration, or a browser tab
240: audio capture) that feeds the same `useAudioCapture` → WebSocket → `ASRProvider`
241: path. No changes to ASR, translation, VAD-interpretation, or refinement layers
242: are expected.
243: 
244: ## 9. Latency budget (target, for tuning once implemented)
245: 
246: | Stage | Target |
247: |---|---|
248: | Client capture → WS send | < 20 ms |
249: | ASR partial result | < 300 ms |
250: | Translation (cloud) | < 150 ms |
251: | Total: speech → on-screen translation | < 500 ms |
252: | LLM refinement (async, non-blocking) | 1–3 s, off critical path |
253: 
254: These are targets to validate against once providers are implemented, not
255: measured results.

1: """
2: WebSocket endpoint for the live audio -> transcript -> translation pipeline.
3: 
4: This is a thin transport layer: it accepts the connection, parses
5: client control/audio messages, and will delegate to the ASR/translation/
6: LLM providers (via their abstract interfaces) once those are
7: implemented. The actual pipeline orchestration (buffering, provider
8: selection, silence-triggered finalization, async refinement dispatch)

10: DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md Phase 2.

13: 
14: import structlog
15: from fastapi import APIRouter, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect
16: 
17: from app.models.schemas import ErrorMessage, WSServerEventType
18: 
19: logger = structlog.get_logger(__name__)
20: 
21: router = APIRouter(prefix="/ws", tags=["websocket"])
22: 
23: 
24: @router.websocket("/audio")
25: async def audio_stream(websocket: WebSocket) -> None:
26:     """
27:     Protocol (see app/models/schemas.py for exact payloads):
28:       Client -> Server:
29:         - JSON {"type": "start", ...SessionStartRequest}
30:         - binary frames: raw PCM16/Opus audio chunks
31:         - JSON {"type": "silence", "duration_ms": N} (from client-side Silero VAD)
32:         - JSON {"type": "stop"}
33:       Server -> Client:
34:         - JSON {"type": "transcript_partial" | "transcript_final", ...}
35:         - JSON {"type": "translation_partial" | "translation_final", ...}
36:         - JSON {"type": "refinement", ...}   (sent later, async)
37:         - JSON {"type": "status" | "error" | "latency", ...}
38:     """
39:     await websocket.accept()
40:     session_id = id(websocket)
41:     logger.info("ws_connected", session_id=session_id)
42: 
43:     try:
44:         while True:
45:             message = await websocket.receive()
46: 
47:             if message.get("type") == "websocket.disconnect":
48:                 break
49: 
50:             if "text" in message and message["text"] is not None:
51:                 # TODO: parse control messages (start/silence/stop) into
52:                 # app.models.schemas types and drive the pipeline.
53:                 logger.debug("ws_text_message", session_id=session_id, raw=message["text"])
54:                 continue
55: 
56:             if "bytes" in message and message["bytes"] is not None:
57:                 # TODO: forward to the active ASRProvider.send_audio(chunk)
58:                 logger.debug(
59:                     "ws_audio_chunk",
60:                     session_id=session_id,
61:                     bytes=len(message["bytes"]),
62:                 )
63:                 continue
64: 
65:     except WebSocketDisconnect:
66:         logger.info("ws_disconnected", session_id=session_id)
67:     except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - surface as a structured error to the client
68:         logger.exception("ws_error", session_id=session_id)
69:         try:
70:             await websocket.send_json(
71:                 {
72:                     "type": WSServerEventType.ERROR.value,
73:                     **ErrorMessage(code="internal_error", message=str(exc)).model_dump(),
74:                 }
75:             )
76:         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - connection may already be closed
77:             pass

1: """
2: ASRProvider: abstract interface for streaming speech-to-text.
3: 
4: Any speech recognition backend (Deepgram, Whisper streaming, Google STT,
5: etc.) implements this interface. The websocket layer and pipeline
6: orchestrator depend only on this abstraction -- never on a concrete
7: provider -- so providers can be swapped or run side-by-side (e.g. for
8: A/B testing or regional failover) without touching business logic.
9: """
10: from __future__ import annotations
11: 
12: from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
13: from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Callable, Awaitable
14: 
15: from app.models.schemas import TranscriptSegment
16: 
17: 
18: class ASRProvider(ABC):
19:     """Streaming ASR contract.
20: 
21:     Implementations receive raw audio frames pushed via `send_audio` and
22:     emit `TranscriptSegment` events (partial and final) through the
23:     async generator returned by `stream()`.
24:     """
25: 
26:     @abstractmethod
27:     async def connect(self, *, sample_rate: int, encoding: str, language: str) -> None:
28:         """Open the upstream connection/session for a single utterance stream."""
29: 
30:     @abstractmethod
31:     async def send_audio(self, chunk: bytes) -> None:
32:         """Push a raw PCM/Opus audio frame to the provider."""
33: 
34:     @abstractmethod
35:     async def notify_silence(self, duration_ms: int) -> None:
36:         """
37:         Inform the provider of a client-detected silence boundary.
38: 
39:         Providers that support endpointing hints (e.g. Deepgram's
40:         `finalize`/`utterance_end`) can use this to force an early final
41:         result and cleaner sentence boundaries.
42:         """
43: 
44:     @abstractmethod
45:     def stream(self) -> AsyncIterator[TranscriptSegment]:
46:         """Yield transcript segments (partial and final) as they arrive."""
47: 
48:     @abstractmethod
49:     async def close(self) -> None:
50:         """Close the upstream connection and release resources."""
51: 
52: 
53: ASRProviderFactory = Callable[[], Awaitable[ASRProvider]]

1: """
2: VADProvider: abstract interface for voice-activity/silence detection.
3: 
4: Silero VAD runs client-side (in an AudioWorklet) for latency reasons,
5: so the backend does not run VAD on the hot path today. This interface
6: exists so the server can:
7:   1) validate/consume silence *events* the client reports (see
8:      `SilenceDetector` below), and
9:   2) later support an optional server-side VAD provider (e.g. for
10:      recorded/meeting-audio ingestion where there is no client worklet),
11:      without changing the pipeline's call sites.
12: """
13: from __future__ import annotations
14: 
15: from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
16: 
17: 
18: class VADProvider(ABC):
19:     @abstractmethod
20:     async def process_frame(self, frame: bytes) -> bool:
21:         """Return True if the frame is classified as speech."""
22: 
23: 
24: class SilenceDetector:
25:     """
26:     Turns raw client VAD events into sentence-boundary decisions.
27: 
28:     The client sends `speech_start` / `speech_end` timestamps (derived
29:     from Silero VAD probabilities). This helper decides, using
30:     `silence_finalize_ms` / `silence_min_speech_ms` from settings,
31:     whether a given silence gap should:
32:       - be ignored (too short / likely a breath pause), or
33:       - trigger `ASRProvider.notify_silence()` to force a clean
34:         utterance boundary and improve punctuation on the final
35:         transcript.
36:     """
37: 
38:     def __init__(self, *, finalize_ms: int, min_speech_ms: int) -> None:
39:         self._finalize_ms = finalize_ms
40:         self._min_speech_ms = min_speech_ms
41:         self._speech_started_at: int | None = None
42: 
43:     def should_finalize(self, *, silence_duration_ms: int, speech_duration_ms: int) -> bool:
44:         if speech_duration_ms < self._min_speech_ms:
45:             return False
46:         return silence_duration_ms >= self._finalize_ms

Let me write wsClient.ts carefully:

```ts
import type { ConnectionState, ServerEvent, SessionStartRequest } from "../types"

export interface TranslatorClientHandlers {
  onEvent: (event: ServerEvent) => void
  onStateChange: (state: ConnectionState) => void
  onError: (message: string) => void
}

const WS_PATH = "/ws/audio"

function wsUrl(): string {
  const host = import.meta.env.VITE_BACKEND_HOST ?? "localhost:8000"
  const useTls = import.meta.env.VITE_BACKEND_USE_TLS === "true"
  const scheme = useTls ? "wss" : "ws"
  return `${scheme}://${host}${WS_PATH}`
}

export class TranslatorClient {
  private socket: WebSocket | null = null
  private state: ConnectionState = "idle"

  constructor(private readonly handlers: TranslatorClientHandlers) {}

  connect(): void {
    if (this.socket) return
    this.setState("connecting")
    const socket = new WebSocket(wsUrl())
    this.socket = socket

    socket.onopen = () => this.setState("connected")
    socket.onmessage = (event: MessageEvent<string>) => {
      try {
        const data = JSON.parse(event.data) as ServerEvent
        this.handlers.onEvent(data)
      } catch {
        this.handlers.onError("Received malformed message from server")
      }
    }
    socket.onerror = () => this.handlers.onError("WebSocket error")
    socket.onclose = () => {
      this.socket = null
      this.setState("disconnected")
    }
  }

  sendStart(start: SessionStartRequest): void {
    this.sendJson({ type: "start", ...start })
  }

  sendSilence(duration_ms: number): void {
    this.sendJson({ type: "silence", duration_ms })
  }

  sendStop(): void {
    this.sendJson({ type: "stop" })
  }

  sendAudio(bytes: Uint8Array): void {
    if (this.socket?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
      this.socket.send(bytes)
    }
  }

  close(): void {
    this.socket?.close()
    this.socket = null
    this.setState("idle")
  }

  get isOpen(): boolean {
    return this.socket?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN
  }

  private sendJson(payload: unknown): void {
    if (this.socket?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
      this.socket.send(JSON.stringify(payload))
    }
  }

  private setState(state: ConnectionState): void {
    this.state = state
    this.handlers.onStateChange(state)
  }
}
```

```ts
import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from "react"

export interface AudioCaptureState {
  stream: MediaStream | null
  error: string | null
  isCapturing: boolean
}

export function useAudioCapture() {
  const [stream, setStream] = useState<MediaStream | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [isCapturing, setIsCapturing] = useState(false)
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null)

  const start = useCallback(async () => {
    setError(null)
    try {
      const mediaStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true })
      streamRef.current = mediaStream
      setStream(mediaStream)
      setIsCapturing(true)
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unable to access microphone")
    }
  }, [])

  const stop = useCallback(() => {
    streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop())
    streamRef.current = null
    setStream(null)
    setIsCapturing(false)
  }, [])

  return { stream, error, isCapturing, start, stop }
}
```

hooks/useTranslatorSession.ts — the seam:
```ts
import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { TranslatorClient } from "../lib/wsClient"
import type { ConnectionState, SessionStartRequest, ServerEvent, TranslationSegment, TranscriptSegment } from "../types"

export interface TranslatorSessionState {
  connectionState: ConnectionState
  transcript: TranscriptSegment[]
  translation: TranslationSegment[]
  latency: number | null
  error: string | null
}

export function useTranslatorSession() {
  const [connectionState, setConnectionState] = useState<ConnectionState>("idle")
  const [transcript, setTranscript] = useState<TranscriptSegment[]>([])
  const [translation, setTranslation] = useState<TranslationSegment[]>([])
  const [latency, setLatency] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const clientRef = useRef<TranslatorClient | null>(null)

  const handleEvent = useCallback((event: ServerEvent) => {
    switch (event.type) {
      case "transcript_partial":
      case "transcript_final": {
        const segment = { segment_id: event.segment_id, text: event.text, is_final: event.is_final, start_ms: event.start_ms, end_ms: event.end_ms, confidence: event.confidence }
        setTranscript((prev) => [...prev.filter((s) => s.segment_id !== event.segment_id), segment])
        break
      }
      case "translation_partial":
      case "translation_final": { ... similar ... break }
      case "latency": setLatency(event.end_to_end_ms ?? null); break
      case "error": setError(event.message); break
      case "status":
      case "refinement":
      default:
        break
    }
  }, [])

  const start = useCallback(async (session: SessionStartRequest) => {
    setError(null)
    if (!clientRef.current) {
      clientRef.current = new TranslatorClient({
        onEvent: handleEvent,
        onStateChange: setConnectionState,
        onError: (message) => setError(message),
      })
    }
    clientRef.current.connect()
    clientRef.current.sendStart(session)
  }, [handleEvent])

  const stop = useCallback(() => {
    clientRef.current?.sendStop()
    clientRef.current?.close()
  }, [])

  return { connectionState, transcript, translation, latency, error, start, stop }
}
```

Hmm, the `handleEvent` uses setState updaters; fine. Note for partial handling, appending filtered by segment_id is a reasonable model.

  const [sourceLanguage, setSourceLanguage] = useState("en-US")
  const [targetLanguage, setTargetLanguage] = useState("es")
  const [isRunning, setIsRunning] = useState(false)
  const session = useTranslatorSession()
  const capture = useAudioCapture()

  const handleStart = useCallback(async () => {
    await capture.start()
    await session.start({ source_language: sourceLanguage, target_language: targetLanguage, sample_rate: 16000, encoding: "linear16" })
    setIsRunning(true)
  }, [capture, session, sourceLanguage, targetLanguage])

  const handleStop = useCallback(() => {
    session.stop()
    capture.stop()
    setIsRunning(false)
  }, [capture, session])

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 p-6 text-slate-900">
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-5xl flex-col gap-4">
        <header className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">Real-Time Translator</h1>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-6">
            <ConnectionStatus state={session.connectionState} />
            <LatencyIndicator latencyMs={session.latency} />
          </div>
        </header>

        <ErrorBanner message={session.error} onDismiss={() => session.dismissError()} />

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-4 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm">
          <LanguageSelector id="source-language" label="Speak in" value={sourceLanguage} options={LANGUAGES} onChange={setSourceLanguage} disabled={isRunning} />
          <LanguageSelector id="target-language" label="Translate to" value={targetLanguage} options={LANGUAGES} onChange={setTargetLanguage} disabled={isRunning} />
          <AudioControls isRunning={isRunning} isCapturing={capture.isCapturing} onStart={handleStart} onStop={handleStop} />
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
          <TranscriptPanel segments={session.transcript} />
          <TranslationPanel segments={session.translation} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  )
}
```

\"localhost:8000\"\n  const useTls = import.meta.env.VITE_BACKEND_USE_TLS === \"true\"\n  const scheme = useTls ? \"wss\" : \"ws\"\n  return `${scheme}://${host}${WS_PATH}`\n}\n\nexport class TranslatorClient {\n  private socket: WebSocket | null = null\n  private state: ConnectionState = \"idle\"\n\n  constructor(private readonly handlers: TranslatorClientHandlers) {}\n\n  connect(): void {\n    if (this.socket) return\n    this.setState(\"connecting\")\n    const socket = new WebSocket(wsUrl())\n    this.socket = socket\n\n    socket.onopen = () => {\n      this.setState(\"connected\")\n    }\n    socket.onmessage = (event: MessageEvent<string>) => {\n      try {\n        const data = JSON.parse(event.data) as ServerEvent\n        this.handlers.onEvent(data)\n      } catch {\n        this.handlers.onError(\"Received a malformed message from the server\")\n      }\n    }\n    socket.onerror = () => {\n      this.handlers.onError(\"WebSocket error\")\n    }\n    socket.onclose = () => {\n      this.socket = null\n      this.setState(\"disconnected\")\n    }\n  }\n\n  sendStart(start: SessionStartRequest): void {\n    this.sendJson({ type: \"start\", ...start })\n  }\n\n  sendSilence(duration_ms: number): void {\n    this.sendJson({ type: \"silence\", duration_ms })\n  }\n\n  sendStop(): void {\n    this.sendJson({ type: \"stop\" })\n  }\n\n  sendAudio(bytes: Uint8Array): void {\n    if (this.socket?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {\n      this.socket.send(bytes)\n    }\n  }\n\n  close(): void {\n    this.socket?.close()\n    this.socket = null\n    this.setState(\"idle\")\n  }\n\n  get isOpen(): boolean {\n    return this.socket?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN\n  }\n\n  private sendJson(payload: unknown): void {\n    if (this.socket?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {\n      this.socket.send(JSON.stringify(payload))\n    }\n  }\n\n  private setState(state: ConnectionState): void {\n    this.state = state\n    this.handlers.onStateChange(state)\n  }\n}\n",

   │                LatencyIndicator, ErrorBanner, TranscriptPanel,\n│       │                TranslationPanel\n│       ├── hooks/       useTranslatorSession, useAudioCapture\n│       ├── providers/  translation, vad, llm), models/, utils/\n│   └── tests/           pytest suite (health, config, websocket, VAD)\n├── docs/              Supplementary docs\n├── tests/             Cross-cutting / Now mock client implementation. Let me write it carefully with setTimeout scheduling and cancellation.

```ts
import type { ConnectionState, LatencyReport, ServerEvent, SessionStartRequest, TranslationSegment, TranscriptSegment } from "../../types"
import type { StreamingClient, StreamingClientHandlers } from "./types"

interface ScenarioUtterance {
  text: string
  translation: string
}

const SCENARIO: ScenarioUtterance[] = [...4 utterances...]

const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms))

export class MockStreamingClient implements StreamingClient {
  private timers = new Set<number>()
  private stopped = false
  private client: StreamingClientHandlers

  constructor(handlers) { this.client = handlers }

  get isOpen() { return !this.stopped }

  connect(): void {
    this.stopped = false
    this.setState("connecting")
    void this.run()
  }

  private emit(event: ServerEvent) { this.client.onEvent(event) }
  private setState(state: ConnectionState) { this.client.onStateChange(state) }
  private setStatus(status: SessionStatus) { this.emit({ type: "session_state", state: status }) }

  private schedule(fn: () => void, ms: number) {
    const id = window.setTimeout(fn, ms)
    this.timers.add(id)
  }

  private async run() {
    try {
      await this.wait(900)
      if (this.stopped) return
      this.setState("connected")
      this.setStatus("connected")
      this.emit({ type: "status", message: "Connected. Ready to listen." })

      await this.wait(600)
      this.setStatus("listening")

      let iteration = 0
      while (!this.stopped) {
        for (const [index, utterance] of SCENARIO.entries()) {
          await this.playUtterance(utterance, index, iteration)
          if (this.stopped) return
        }
        if (iteration === 0) {
          await this.demoError()
          if (this.stopped) return
        }
        iteration += 1
        await this.wait(1500)
      }
    } catch {
      // cancelled
    }
  }

  private async playUtterance(utterance, index, iteration) {
    const segmentId = `seg-${iteration}-${index}`
    const words = utterance.text.split(" ")
    const partialCount = Math.max(3, Math.min(5, words.length))
    const step = Math.ceil(words.length / partialCount)

    this.setStatus("speaking")
    this.emitLatency(index)

    for (let i = step; i <= words.length; i += step) {
      const partial = words.slice(0, i).join(" ")
      this.emit({ type: "transcript_partial", segment_id: segmentId, text: partial, is_final: false })
      await this.wait(420 + (i % 3) * 90)
      if (this.stopped) return
    }

    this.emit({ type: "transcript_final", segment_id: segmentId, text: utterance.text, is_final: true, confidence: 0.9 + Math.random()*0.09 })
    await this.wait(350)

    this.setStatus("silence")
    this.emit({ type: "latency", segment_id: segmentId, asr_ms: 210, translation_ms: 120, end_to_end_ms: 330 })
    await this.wait(500)

    this.setStatus("translating")
    const twords = utterance.translation.split(" ")
    const tcount = Math.max(3, Math.min(5, twords.length))
    const tstep = Math.ceil(twords.length / tcount)
    for (let i = tstep; i <= twords.length; i += tstep) {
      const partial = twords.slice(0, i).join(" ")
      this.emit({ type: "translation_partial", segment_id: segmentId, source_text: utterance.text, translated_text: partial, source_language: "en", target_language: "es", is_final: false, provider: "mock" })
      await this.wait(260)
      if (this.stopped) return
    }
    this.emit({ type: "translation_final", segment_id: segmentId, source_text: utterance.text, translated_text: utterance.translation, source_language: "en", target_language: "es", is_final: true, provider: "mock" })

    await this.wait(700)
    this.setStatus("listening")
    this.emitLatency(index)
  }

  private async demoError() {
    this.emit({ type: "error", code: "connection_lost", message: "Connection lost. Reconnecting…" })
    this.setState("reconnecting")
    await this.wait(1200)
    if (this.stopped) return
    this.setState("connected")
    this.setStatus("listening")
    this.emit({ type: "status", message: "Reconnected." })
  }

  private emitLatency(seed: number) {
    const variance = (seed % 3) * 40
    this.emit({ type: "latency", segment_id: "lat", asr_ms: 190 + variance, translation_ms: 110 + variance, end_to_end_ms: 300 + variance })
  }

  private async wait(ms) { return new Promise((resolve) => { const id = window.setTimeout(resolve, ms); this.timers.add(id) }) }

  sendStart(...) {}  // no-op in mock
  sendStop() {}
  sendAudio() {}
  sendSilence() {}

  close() {
    this.stopped = true
    this.timers.forEach(clearTimeout)
    this.timers.clear()
  }
}
```

  | ({ type: "translation_partial" | "translation_final" } & TranslationSegment)
  | ({ type: "refinement" } & RefinementResult)
  | ({ type: "session_state"; state: SessionStatus })
  | ({ type: "status"; message: string })
  | ({ type: "error"; code: string; message: string })
  | ({ type: "latency" } & LatencyReport)

import type { LanguageOption } from "../types"

export interface LanguageDefinition extends LanguageOption {
  nativeName: string
}

export const AUTO_DETECT: LanguageOption = { code: "auto", label: "Auto Detect" }

const BASE_LANGUAGES: LanguageDefinition[] = [
  { code: "en", label: "English", nativeName: "English" },
  { code: "hi", label: "Hindi", nativeName: "हिन्दी" },
  { code: "ta", label: "Tamil", nativeName: "தமிழ்" },
  { code: "te", label: "Telugu", nativeName: "తెలుగు" },
  { code: "ml", label: "Malayalam", nativeName: "മലയാളം" },
  { code: "kn", label: "Kannada", nativeName: "ಕನ್ನಡ" },
  { code: "es", label: "Spanish", nativeName: "Español" },
  { code: "fr", label: "French", nativeName: "Français" },
  { code: "de", label: "German", nativeName: "Deutsch" },
  { code: "pt", label: "Portuguese", nativeName: "Português" },
  { code: "ja", label: "Japanese", nativeName: "日本語" },
  { code: "ko", label: "Korean", nativeName: "한국어" },
  { code: "zh", label: "Chinese", nativeName: "中文" },
  { code: "ar", label: "Arabic", nativeName: "العربية" },
  { code: "ru", label: "Russian", nativeName: "Русский" },
]

function parseExtraLanguages(): LanguageDefinition[] {
  const raw = import.meta.env.VITE_EXTRA_LANGUAGES
  if (!raw) return []
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(raw)
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return []
    return parsed
      .filter((item): item is Record<string, unknown> => typeof item === "object" && item !== null)
      .map((item) => ({
        code: String(item.code),
        label: String(item.label),
        nativeName: item.nativeName === undefined ? String(item.label) : String(item.nativeName),
      }))
  } catch {
    return []
  }
}

export const LANGUAGES: LanguageDefinition[] = [...BASE_LANGUAGES, ...parseExtraLanguages()]

export const SOURCE_LANGUAGES: LanguageOption[] = [AUTO_DETECT, ...LANGUAGES]

export function findLanguage(code: string): LanguageDefinition | undefined {
  return LANGUAGES.find((language) => language.code === code)
}

export function languageLabel(code: string): string {
  const found = findLanguage(code)
  return found ? found.label : code
}

run():
```ts
private async run(): Promise<void> {
  await this.sleep(900)
  if (this.stopped) return
  this.setConnectionState("connected")
  this.setStatus("listening")
  this.emitStatus("Connected. Streaming will start when you begin speaking.")

  await this.sleep(800)

  let pass = 0
  while (!this.stopped) {
    for (const utterance of SCENARIO) {
      await this.playUtterance(utterance)
      if (this.stopped) return
    }
    pass += 1
    if (pass === 1) {
      await this.simulateDisconnect()
      if (this.stopped) return
    }
    await this.sleep(1200)
  }
}

playUtterance:
```ts
private async playUtterance(utterance: ScenarioUtterance): Promise<void> {
  const segmentId = `seg-${this.sequence}`
  this.sequence += 1

  this.setStatus("speaking")
  const words = utterance.text.split(" ")
  const partialSteps = Math.min(4, Math.max(2, Math.ceil(words.length / 2)))
  const stepSize = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(words.length / partialSteps))
  const partialCount = Math.ceil(words.length / stepSize)

  for (let i = 1; i <= partialCount; i += 1) {
    const end = i * stepSize
    const text = words.slice(0, end).join(" ")
    this.emitTranscript(segmentId, text, false)
    await this.sleep(360 + (i % 3) * 60)
    if (this.stopped) return
  }

  this.emitTranscript(segmentId, utterance.text, true)
  await this.sleep(300)
  if (this.stopped) return

  this.setStatus("silence")
  this.emitLatency(segmentId)
  await this.sleep(450)
  if (this.stopped) return

  this.setStatus("translating")
  const translationWords = utterance.translation.split(" ")
  const tSteps = Math.min(4, Math.max(2, Math.ceil(translationWords.length / 2)))
  const tStepSize = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(translationWords.length / tSteps))
  const tPartialCount = Math.ceil(translationWords.length / tStepSize)

  for (let i = 1; i <= tPartialCount; i += 1) {
    const end = i * tStepSize
    const text = translationWords.slice(0, end).join(" ")
    this.emitTranslation(segmentId, utterance.text, text, false)
    await this.sleep(240 + (i % 3) * 40)
    if (this.stopped) return
  }

  this.emitTranslation(segmentId, utterance.text, utterance.translation, true)

  if (utterance.refinement) {
    const refinedText = utterance.refinement.text
    this.schedule(() => {
      if (this.stopped) return
      this.emit({ type: "refinement", segment_id: segmentId, refined_text: refinedText, changed: true })
    }, 1400)
  }

  await this.sleep(600)
  if (this.stopped) return
  this.setStatus("listening")
}
```

simulateDisconnect:
```ts
private async simulateDisconnect(): Promise<void> {
  this.setStatus("error")
  this.emitError("connection_lost", "Connection lost. Attempting to reconnect…")
  this.setConnectionState("reconnecting")
  await this.sleep(1400)
  if (this.stopped) return
  this.setConnectionState("connected")
  this.setStatus("listening")
  this.emitStatus("Reconnected successfully.")
}
```

emit helpers:
```ts
private emit(event: ServerEvent): void { this.handlers.onEvent(event) }
private setConnectionState(state: ConnectionState): void { this.handlers.onStateChange(state) }
private setStatus(status: SessionStatus): void { this.emit({ type: "session_state", state: status }) }
private emitStatus(message: string): void { this.emit({ type: "status", message }) }
private emitError(code: string, message: string): void { this.emit({ type: "error", code, message }) }
private emitTranscript(segmentId, text, is_final) { this.emit({ type: is_final ? "transcript_final" : "transcript_partial", segment_id: segmentId, text, is_final }) }
private emitTranslation(segmentId, sourceText, translatedText, isFinal) {
  this.emit({ type: isFinal ? "translation_final" : "translation_partial", segment_id: segmentId, source_text: sourceText, translated_text: translatedText, source_language: "en", target_language: "es", is_final: isFinal, provider: "mock" })
}
private emitLatency(segmentId: string) {
  const jitter = Math.floor(Math.random() * 80)
  this.emit({ type: "latency", segment_id: segmentId, asr_ms: 180 + jitter, translation_ms: 110 + jitter / 2, end_to_end_ms: 290 + jitter + 60 })
}
```

sleep & schedule:
```ts
private sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const id = window.setTimeout(resolve, ms)
    this.timers.add(id)
  })
}
private schedule(fn: () => void, ms: number): void {
  const id = window.setTimeout(() => { this.timers.delete(id); fn() }, ms)
  this.timers.add(id)
}
```

Now useTranslatorSession rewrite:

```ts
import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { TranslatorClient } from "../lib/wsClient"
import { MockStreamingClient } from "../providers/streaming/mockStreamingClient"
import type { StreamingClient } from "../providers/streaming/types"
import type {
  ConnectionState,
  LatencyReport,
  ServerEvent,
  SessionMode,
  SessionStartRequest,
  SessionStatus,
  TranslationSegment,
  TranscriptSegment,
} from "../types"

export interface TranslatorSession {
  connectionState: ConnectionState
  status: SessionStatus
  transcriptSegments: TranscriptSegment[]
  partialText: string
  translationSegments: TranslationSegment[]
  latestTranslation: TranslationSegment | null
  latency: LatencyReport | null
  error: string | null
  start: (session: SessionStartRequest) => void
  stop: () => void
  dismissError: () => void
}

export function useTranslatorSession({ mode = "mock" }: { mode?: SessionMode } = {}): TranslatorSession {
  const [connectionState, setConnectionState] = useState<ConnectionState>("idle")
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<SessionStatus>("idle")
  const [transcriptSegments, setTranscriptSegments] = useState<TranscriptSegment[]>([])
  const [partialText, setPartialText] = useState("")
  const [translationSegments, setTranslationSegments] = useState<TranslationSegment[]>([])
  const [latestTranslation, setLatestTranslation] = useState<TranslationSegment | null>(null)
  const [latency, setLatency] = useState<LatencyReport | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const clientRef = useRef<StreamingClient | null>(null)
  const modeRef = useRef(mode)
  modeRef.current = mode

  const handleConnectionState = useCallback((state: ConnectionState) => {
    setConnectionState(state)
    if (state === "connecting" || state === "reconnecting") {
      setStatus(state === "reconnecting" ? "reconnecting" : "connecting")
    } else if (state === "connected") {
      setStatus((current) => (current === "idle" || current === "connecting" ? "connected" : current))
    } else if (state === "disconnected") {
      setStatus((current) => (current === "error" ? "error" : "disconnected"))
    }
  }, [])

  const handleEvent = useCallback((event: ServerEvent) => {
    switch (event.type) {
      case "session_state":
        setStatus(event.state)
        if (event.state === "connected" || event.state === "listening") {
          setError(null)
        }
        break
      case "transcript_partial":
        setPartialText(event.text)
        break
      case "transcript_final": {
        const segment: TranscriptSegment = {
          segment_id: event.segment_id,
          text: event.text,
          is_final: true,
          start_ms: event.start_ms,
          end_ms: event.end_ms,
          confidence: event.confidence,
        }
        setTranscriptSegments((prev) => [
          ...prev.filter((s) => s.segment_id !== event.segment_id),
          segment,
        ])
        setPartialText("")
        break
      }
      case "translation_partial": {
        const segment: TranslationSegment = { ... }
        setLatestTranslation(segment)
        break
      }
      case "translation_final": {
        const segment: TranslationSegment = { ... }
        setLatestTranslation(segment)
        setTranslationSegments((prev) => [...prev.filter((s) => s.segment_id !== event.segment_id), segment])
        break
      }
      case "refinement":
        setTranscriptSegments((prev) =>
          prev.map((s) =>
            s.segment_id === event.segment_id ? { ...s, text: event.refined_text, refined: true } : s,
          ),
        )
        break
      case "latency":
        setLatency(event)
        break
      case "error":
        setError(event.message)
        setStatus("error")
        break
      case "status":
        break
    }
  }, [])

  const start = useCallback((session: SessionStartRequest) => {
    setError(null)
    setTranscriptSegments([])
    setTranslationSegments([])
    setPartialText("")
    setLatestTranslation(null)
    setLatency(null)
    setStatus("connecting")

    if (clientRef.current) {
      clientRef.current.close()
    }

    const handlers = {
      onEvent: handleEvent,
      onStateChange: handleConnectionState,
      onError: (message: string) => setError(message),
    }

    clientRef.current =
      modeRef.current === "live" ? new TranslatorClient(handlers) : new MockStreamingClient(handlers)

    clientRef.current.connect()
    clientRef.current.sendStart(session)
  }, [handleEvent, handleConnectionState])

  const stop = useCallback(() => {
    clientRef.current?.sendStop()
    clientRef.current?.close()
    clientRef.current = null
    setConnectionState("idle")
    setStatus("idle")
  }, [])

  const dismissError = useCallback(() => setError(null), [])

  return {
    connectionState,
    status,
    transcriptSegments,
    partialText,
    translationSegments,
    latestTranslation,
    latency,
    error,
    start,
    stop,
    dismissError,
  }
}
```

But after mock "error" → reconnecting → connected, current status is "error"/"reconnecting"; then session_state "listening" will follow from mock. In live mode, after connected, status stays "connected" — fine. But in mock, after connect, mock emits session_state "listening". Good.

Also when disconnected during error demo: mock doesn't emit disconnected. OK.

useAudioCapture with simulate:

```ts
export function useAudioCapture({ simulate = false }: { simulate?: boolean } = {}) {
  const [stream, setStream] = useState<MediaStream | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [isCapturing, setIsCapturing] = useState(false)
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null)
  const simulateRef = useRef(simulate)
  simulateRef.current = simulate

  const start = useCallback(async (): Promise<boolean> => {
    setError(null)
    if (simulateRef.current) {
      setIsCapturing(true)
      return true
    }
    try {
      const mediaStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true })
      streamRef.current = mediaStream
      setStream(mediaStream)
      setIsCapturing(true)
      return true
    } catch (cause) {
      setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Unable to access the microphone")
      return false
    }
  }, [])

  const stop = useCallback(() => {
    streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop())
    streamRef.current = null
    setStream(null)
    setIsCapturing(false)
  }, [])

  return { stream, error, isCapturing, start, stop }
}
```

```tsx
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import type { LanguageOption } from "../../types"
import { ChevronDownIcon, SearchIcon } from "../icons"

export interface SearchableLanguageSelectProps {
  id: string
  label: string
  value: string
  options: LanguageOption[]
  onChange: (code: string) => void
  disabled?: boolean
  placeholder?: string
}

export function SearchableLanguageSelect({
  id,
  label,
  value,
  options,
  onChange,
  disabled = false,
  placeholder = "Select a language",
}: SearchableLanguageSelectProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("")
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0)
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
  const searchRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null)

  const selected = options.find((option) => option.code === value)

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase()
    if (!q) return options
    return options.filter((option) =>
      [option.label, option.code].some((part) => part.toLowerCase().includes(q)),
    )
  }, [options, query])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setQuery("")
      setActiveIndex(0)
      searchRef.current?.focus()
    }
  }, [open])

  useEffect(() => {
    function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (!open) return
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        setOpen(false)
        return
      }
      if (event.key === "ArrowDown") {
        event.preventDefault()
        setActiveIndex((i) => Math.min(i + 1, filtered.length - 1))
        return
      }
      if (event.key === "ArrowUp") {
        event.preventDefault()
        setActiveIndex((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0))
        return
      }
      if (event.key === "Enter" && filtered[activeIndex]) {
        event.preventDefault()
        onChange(filtered[activeIndex].code)
        setOpen(false)
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown)
  }, [open, filtered, activeIndex, onChange])

  useEffect(() => {
    function onPointerDown(event: MouseEvent) {
      if (rootRef.current && !rootRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setOpen(false)
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown)
  }, [])

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className="relative flex flex-col gap-1">
      <span className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">{label}</span>
      <button
        id={id}
        type="button"
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}
        aria-haspopup="listbox"
        aria-expanded={open}
        className="flex w-56 items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-md border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm shadow-sm focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
      >
        <span className={selected ? "truncate text-slate-900" : "truncate text-slate-400"}>
          {selected ? selected.label : placeholder}
        </span>
        <ChevronDownIcon className={`h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-slate-400 transition-transform ${open ? "rotate-180" : ""}`} />
      </button>

      {open && (
        <div className="absolute top-full z-20 mt-1 w-56 overflow-hidden rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-lg">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-100 px-3 py-2">
            <SearchIcon className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-400" />
            <input
              ref={searchRef}
              type="text"
              value={query}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setQuery(event.target.value)
                setActiveIndex(0)
              }}
              placeholder="Search languages…"
              aria-label={`Search ${label.toLowerCase()}`}
              className="w-full bg-transparent text-sm text-slate-700 outline-none placeholder:text-slate-400"
            />
          </div>
          <ul role="listbox" aria-labelledby={id} className="max-h-56 overflow-y-auto py-1">
            {filtered.map((option, index) => (
              <li
                key={option.code}
                role="option"
                aria-selected={option.code === value}
                onMouseEnter={() => setActiveIndex(index)}
                onClick={() => {
                  onChange(option.code)
                  setOpen(false)
                }}
                className={`flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 text-sm ${
                  index === activeIndex ? "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700" : "text-slate-700"
                }`}
              >
                <span>{option.label}</span>
                {option.code === value && <span className="text-indigo-500">✓</span>}
              </li>
            ))}
            {filtered.length === 0 && (
              <li className="px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-400">No languages match "{query}"</li>
            )}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

Note: `LanguageOption` from types has code,label. Good. The `nativeName` is in config's LanguageDefinition but component only needs code/label. Options passed in are `LanguageOption[]` — the config arrays extend it. Good.

Dropdown width w-56 consistent with button w-56. Good.

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react"
import type { SessionStatus, TranscriptSegment } from "../../types"

export interface TranscriptPanelProps {
  segments: TranscriptSegment[]
  partial: string
  status: SessionStatus
}

export function TranscriptPanel({ segments, partial, status }: TranscriptPanelProps) {
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ top: scrollRef.current.scrollHeight, behavior: "smooth" })
  }, [segments, partial])

  const isActive = status === "speaking" || status === "listening"

  return (
    <section className="flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm">
      <header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 px-4 py-3">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Transcript</h2>
        <StatusChip status={status} />
      </header>
      <div ref={scrollRef} className="flex h-80 flex-col gap-2 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-3">
        {segments.length === 0 && !partial && (
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">Captions will appear here while you speak.</p>
        )}
        {segments.map((segment) => (
          <p key={segment.segment_id} className="text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-slate-800">
            {segment.text}
            {segment.refined && <span className="ml-2 rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-indigo-500">refined</span>}
          </p>
        ))}
        {partial && (
          <p className={`flex items-start gap-2 text-[15px] leading-relaxed italic text-slate-500 ${isActive ? "animate-pulse" : ""}`}>
            <span className="mt-1 h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
            {partial}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}

function StatusChip({ status }: { status: SessionStatus }) {
  const map: Partial<Record<SessionStatus, { label: string; className: string }>> = {
    speaking: { label: "Speaking", className: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700" },
    silence: { label: "Silence", className: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-500" },
    listening: { label: "Listening", className: "bg-sky-100 text-sky-700" },
  }
  const meta = map[status]
  if (!meta) return null
  return <span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium ${meta.className}`}>{meta.label}</span>
}
```

```tsx
import { useEffect } from "react"
import type { SessionMode } from "../../types"
import { XIcon } from "../icons"

export interface SettingsModalProps {
  open: boolean
  mode: SessionMode
  showLatency: boolean
  latencyToggleAvailable: boolean
  onModeChange: (mode: SessionMode) => void
  onShowLatencyChange: (value: boolean) => void
  onClose: () => void
}

export function SettingsModal({ open, mode, showLatency, latencyToggleAvailable, onModeChange, onShowLatencyChange, onClose }: SettingsModalProps) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.key === "Escape") onClose()
    }
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown)
  }, [open, onClose])

  if (!open) return null

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Settings">
      <button type="button" className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-900/40" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close settings" />
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md rounded-xl bg-white p-5 shadow-xl">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-slate-900">Settings</h2>
          <button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close" className="rounded p-1 hover:bg-slate-100">
            <XIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-4">
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            <span className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">Connection mode</span>
            <select value={mode} onChange={(e) => onModeChange(e.target.value as SessionMode)} className="...">
              <option value="mock">Mock demo (simulated stream)</option>
              <option value="live">Live WebSocket</option>
            </select>
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">Mock mode simulates the streaming pipeline without a backend.</span>
          </label>

          {latencyToggleAvailable && (
            <label className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <span className="text-sm text-slate-700">Show latency indicator</span>
              <input type="checkbox" checked={showLatency} onChange={(e) => onShowLatencyChange(e.target.checked)} className="h-4 w-4 rounded border-slate-300 text-indigo-600 focus:ring-indigo-500" />
            </label>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```
